name: stop_selected_object_movement_and_set_animation

stack.evidence: func_001D17D0 consumes an animation ID and blend duration, ORs the animation ID with 0x10000, and queues object operation type 17

notes: The embedded operation-name table labels type 17 STOP_MOVE. Its dispatcher clears the selected object's active movement state, then passes the flagged animation ID and blend duration to the normal motion-request initializer. The JP corpus contains 73 calls; 66 use animation 201 or 202.
